channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Aquarist
item.description: Build beautiful aquariums, care for exotic marine life, complete creative customer jobs, and grow your own aquarium business into a world-class oceanarium in this relaxing sandbox simulation.

item.title: Blood Dungeon
item.description: From the creators of Nidhogg, murder hordes of monsters in this 2D platforming autoshooter with a killer soundtrack. Collect Blood, gold, and bones to increase your powers. Can you survive the Blood Dungeon?

item.title: Forza Horizon 6
item.description: Discover the breathtaking landscapes of Japan in over 550 real-world cars and become a racing Legend in Forza Horizon's biggest open world driving adventure yet.

item.title: Funguys Swarm
item.description: Funguys Swarm is a cartoony survivor bullet hell where the forest is on fire. Become a Funguy, arm yourself with forest-crafted weapons, and unleash some bonkers powers on the Fireking’s army. And maybe... just maybe, save the day if you’re skilled (or lucky) enough.

item.title: Gedonia 2
item.description: Gedonia 2 is an online coop RPG, which allows up to 4 players to freely explore living open world and build absolutely unique characters. An expanded and improved sequel for RPG Gedonia.

item.title: Mega Man Battle Network Legacy Collection Vol. 2
item.description: The renowned Mega Man Battle Network series, which has expanded into anime and comics, is back. Volume 2 includes six action packed games from both versions of Mega Man Battle Network 4 to both versions of Mega Man Battle Network 6, plus additional features like a gallery and online play!

item.title: Mega Man Legacy Collection
item.description: Mega Man Legacy Collection is a celebration of the 8-bit history of Capcom’s iconic Blue Bomber featuring faithful reproductions of the series’ origins with the original six Mega Man games.

item.title: Polylithic
item.description: Polylithic is a survival game unlike any other, set in the most pivotal moment in mankind's history. Experience life as a Paleolithic hunter-gatherer, settle down as a Neolithic farmer, form tribes in co-op multiplayer, or go it alone in a world where the apex predator is still a distant aspiration.

item.title: SeaColony
item.description: SeaColony is a survival colony-builder set on the open sea. Build and expand a floating colony, manage colonists, research technologies, and develop farming, fishing, production, and power systems. Trade with merchant ships and survive pirate raids, fires, and harsh weather as your colony grows.

item.title: Terminator: Resistance
item.description: Terminator: Resistance, is a first-person shooter set during the 'Future War' scenario that was only glimpsed at in the iconic films, 'THE TERMINATOR' and 'T2: JUDGMENT DAY'. The machines are destined to lose, but at what cost?

item.title: Train Sim World® 7
item.description: Live life on the tracks and discover the joy of train simulation. Whether looking for a relaxing run on the rails or seeking the thrill of mastering your virtual train driver career, find your way in Train Sim World 7.

item.title: Hero Siege - Extra Inventory & Stash Space
item.description: +1 Stash and Inventory Tab

item.title: House Builder
item.description: Become a one-man construction crew! Travel around the world and through the ages to build iconic designs! Beware of unpleasant temperatures and dangerous fauna!

item.title: MEGA MAN X DiVE Offline
item.description: Mega Man X DiVE reimagined the world of the Mega Man X series, and now it's getting an offline version! Strengthen your characters and weapons with a variety of powerups to make them all your own. Then test them out in the side-scrolling action of "what-if" worlds in Mega Man X!

item.title: Hero Siege - Prophet (Class)
item.description: The Prophet is a versatile character class capable of spell casting, summoning minions or phase shifting into various creatures of the wilderness. She is one with the nature and channels the energy of the forest to fight by her side.

item.title: Mega Man Legacy Collection 2
item.description: The Blue Bomber is back in this second collection of classic Capcom titles! Featuring faithful reproductions of Mega Man 7, 8, 9, & 10, this collection is bursting with additional content, from time trials and remix challenges to a music player and an extensive gallery of rare illustrations.

item.title: Mega Man X Legacy Collection 2
item.description: Complete the exciting Mega Man X saga with four action-packed titles! This collection showcases the evolution of the series with Mega Man X5, Mega Man X6, Mega Man X7, and Mega Man X8. Test your skills in the new X Challenge mode, which pits players against two deadly bosses at once.

item.title: Senren＊Banka
item.description: Senren＊Banka is a Japanese-style visual novel produced by Yuzusoft, a Japanese developer of romance VNs. This game commemorated Yuzusoft's 10th anniversary. It won numerous awards on the year of its release in Japan for its art, music, and characters.

item.title: Smashing Bottles
item.description: Smashing Bottles is a short and satisfying incremental game where you break bottles to earn money, upgrade your bat, discover new bottles, and cause chaos! Will you smash enough bottles to buy the universe?

item.title: Carrier Command 2
item.description: Carrier Command 2 is the real-time strategy game that puts you in command of a futuristic carrier capable of deploying a vast array of aircraft and amphibious units. Compete against AI or human players and hop into every single vehicle to take matters into your own hands!

item.title: Crimson Desert
item.description: Crimson Desert is an open-world action-adventure set on the continent of Pywel. Join Kliff on his journey to rebuild the Greymane faction and to save the land from a looming threat. From vast wilderness and cities to ruins and the mysterious Abyss, forge your path through battles and discovery.

item.title: Dokimon: The Great Fairy Island
item.description: Hop in your *all new* Hovercraft or Submarine and explore "The Great Fairy Island" in this short side-story DLC where the Xer's are once again up to their shenanigans!

item.title: Eternal Strands
item.description: A next-generation action experience where the elements obey you, the terrain bends to your will, and every victory is entirely your own.

item.title: Here Comes The Swarm
item.description: Here Comes the Swarm is a survival RTS with a pause button! Create your strategy, build, manage, and defend your settlements at your own pace. Take the fight to the hive mind and lead expeditions to deliver a deadly blow and eradicate your foes. Will you reclaim Ulora from the relentless Swarm?

item.title: Hero Siege - Bard (Class)
item.description: Shred the battlefield with face-melting solos and thunderous riffs! The Bard storms into Hero Siege with amps cranked to 11, fusing the fury of death metal with the raw brutality of the pit.

item.title: Hero Siege - Butcher Class
item.description: The Butcher epitomizes brute strength and an insatiable thirst for carnage. With each strike of his trusty cleaver, he revels in the symphony of bloodshed. Fueled by a primal urge to rend flesh and crush bone, the Butcher is both feared and revered on the battlefield.

item.title: Hero Siege - Exo Class
item.description: The Prophet of the sun and moon. She embodies the celestial duality of light and darkness, inflicting freezing cold damage and burning her enemies to cinders. She can control the power of the solar system leaving behind a trail of absolute destruction.

item.title: Hero Siege - Stormweaver
item.description: The Stormweaver commands the tempestuous power of thunder and lightning, shocking through the undead with electrifying grace. With each crack of thunder and flash of lightning she leaves the battlefields full of steaming ash.

item.title: Mega Man 11
item.description: Mega Man is back! The newest entry in this iconic series blends classic, challenging 2D platforming action with a fresh new visual style. The new Double Gear system boosts Mega Man's speed and power for a new twist to the satisfying gameplay the series is known for.

item.title: Mega Man Star Force Legacy Collection
item.description: The Mega Man Star Force series, which expanded into an anime, is back in the Mega Man Star Force Legacy Collection! This collection includes seven games and additional features like a gallery of illustrations and music! Online play is also supported!

item.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition
item.description: Take to the skies in the World’s favourite flight simulator! The multi award winning Microsoft Flight Simulator X lands on Steam for the first time. Take off from anywhere in the world, flying some of the world’s most iconic aircraft to any one of 24,000 destinations.

item.title: Bar After Bar
item.description: Bar After Bar is a multiplayer game where 5 friends drive to the top of a mountain. You will be mixing drinks and throwing them at each other the whole way up. The drunker you get, the harder it is to drive. How far can you make it?

item.title: Combolands: Roguelike Citybuilder
item.description: A mini citybuilding roguelike. Place buildings, stack combos, and master deep strategy in short bursts to create a tiny thriving metropolis!

item.title: Din's Champion
item.description: The evil goddess seeks to devour and remake the world… and you are what stands in her way. Fight and kill, expand your skill tree, craft and build, and lead the world’s people to victory in Din’s Champion, a multiplayer fantasy action-RPG where every choice matters, and the choices are endless.

item.title: Dokimon Quest
item.description: A monster-taming RPG meets GBC-era nostalgia. Capture and train 140+ Dokimon across 15+ towns. "Whoa, watch out — Dokimon are dangerous!" Uncover the mystery behind your missing childhood friend in the Xelos region.

item.title: Dragon's Dogma 2
item.description: Dragon’s Dogma 2 is a single player, narrative driven action-RPG that challenges the players to choose their own experience – from the appearance of their Arisen, their vocation, their party, how to approach different situations and more - in a truly immersive fantasy world.

item.title: Eslabong
item.description: Arena combat meets mercenary club management. Recruit from a dynamic market, build your squad, and compete season after season in leagues and cups.

item.title: FEED THE AI
item.description: Feed the AI. Collect data. Unlock upgrades. Watch the algorithm grow beyond your control. An active incremental where you feed an evolving AI with data and shape what it becomes. Will it save the world... or take it over?

item.title: Iron Blight
item.description: Iron Blight is a survival horror game set in a cold, rainy Eastern Bloc town. You are trapped in a room as abominations claw at your door, with nowhere to run. You must survive the feverish night, uncover the horrors lurking in the shadows, and above all, find your wife, Valeria.

item.title: Loot Frog
item.description: Loot Frog is an incremental action bullet hell about breaking pots, collecting gems, and fighting an evil cult. Upgrade your gear, unlock new abilities, explore diverse biomes, and push deeper into increasingly chaotic battles.

item.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator Suite: Themes Reimagined
item.description: Fully immerse yourself in the world of flight with this digital soundtrack to accompany you on your aviation journey. This suite of 21 unreleased original pieces is inspired by popular trailer scores created by Finishing Move Inc. for Microsoft Flight Simulator.

item.title: Money for Girls: Amortized
item.description: A girl detective faces her darkest mystery yet, in this horror-romance visual novel with stickers, fashion, and bad ends.

item.title: Ryse: Son of Rome
item.description: “Ryse: Son of Rome” tells the story of Marius Titus, a young Roman soldier who witnesses the murder of his family at the hands of barbarian bandits, then travels with the Roman army to Britannia to seek revenge.

item.title: Titanic Escape Simulator™
item.description: Investigate a dark mystery aboard the RMS Titanic before the final night becomes a fight for survival. Explore, solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and make impossible choices as history’s most famous ship sinks beneath the Atlantic.

item.title: Union Of Rivals
item.description: A deep colony sim and city builder. Manage resources and production chains to build the railroad from East to West. Found towns, harvest and refine the goods that fuel the line, then persuade or outlast the settlements in your path. Every citizen has a name, a trait, and a breaking point.

item.title: Yakuza 0 Director's Cut
item.description: Discover the decadence and danger of 1980's Japan as you fight like hell through its neon-lit entertainment districts in the definitive edition of the action-adventure crime drama that created yakuza legends.
